spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (लोष्टते)
To heap, to assemble, to collect or gather into a heap.

mn. (-ष्टः-ष्टं)
A clod, a lump of earth.
n. (-ष्टं)
Rust of iron or iron filings.
E.
लोष्ट to heap, aff. अच्; or लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. क्त, with change of the radical vowel, and सुट् augment; also with कन् added लोष्टक.

m. (-घ्नः)
A harrow.
E.
लोष्ट a clod, and घ्न destroying.

m. (-नः)
A harrow.
E.
लोष्ट a clod, and भेदन what breaks.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of a clod or of earth.
E.
लोष्ट, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिणी-र्द्दि)
Who or what breaks clods of earth.
E.
लोष्ट, and मर्द्दिन् who destroys.

m. (-ष्टुः)
A lump of earth.
E.
लोष्ट to heap, उ aff.
